notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one card in hand.
"Pegasus" chosen with Kindred Discovery.
description:
Activate Pegasus Refuge by paying {2} and discarding a card, creating a 1/1 Pegasus creature token.
When the Pegasus enters the battlefield, Kindred Discovery triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Pegasus, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
